import csv
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
main = root / \"main.py\"
passed = 0


def run(data: bytes, *args: str):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        path = Path(td) / \"input.csv\"
        path.write_bytes(data)
        before = path.read_bytes()
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(main), str(path), *args],
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        assert path.read_bytes() == before, \"input file was modified\"
        return result


def ok(name, data, args, expected, output=\"json\"):
    global passed
    r = run(data, *args)
    assert r.returncode == 0, f\"{name}: rc={r.returncode}, stderr={r.stderr"'!r}"
    if output == "json":
        actual = json.loads(r.stdout)
    else:
        actual = list(csv.reader(r.stdout.splitlines(keepends=True)))
    assert actual == expected, f"{name}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}"
    passed += 1


def bad(name, data, args, needles):
    global passed
    r = run(data, *args)
    assert r.returncode != 0, f"{name}: unexpectedly succeeded: {r.stdout!r}"
    text = r.stderr.lower()
    for needle in needles:
        assert needle.lower() in text, f"{name}: {needle!r} absent from {r.stderr!r}"
    assert r.stdout == "", f"{name}: partial stdout emitted: {r.stdout!r}"
    passed += 1

])

])

], \"csv\")

import csv
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
MAIN = ROOT / \"main.py\"

def run(path, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(MAIN), str(path), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)

def ok(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    d = Path(td)
    source = d / \"data.csv\"
    original = 'team,note,amount,other\\r\\nb,\"hello, world\",1.20,2\\r\\na,\"line1\\nline2\",0.01,4\\r\\nb,x,1.80,6\\r\\n'
    source.write_bytes(original.encode())

    p = run(source)
    ok(p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
    rows = json.loads(p.stdout)
    ok(rows[1][\"note\"] == \"line1\\nline2\" and len(rows) == 3, \"RFC CSV/JSON failed\")

    p = run(source, \"--where\", \"team=b\", \"--where\", \"note=x\", \"--output\", \"csv\")
    ok(p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
    parsed = list(csv.reader(p.stdout.splitlines()))
    ok(parsed == [[\"team\", \"note\", \"amount\", \"other\"], [\"b\", \"x\", \"1.80\", \"6\"]], \"filters/CSV failed\")

    p = run(source, \"--group-by\", \"team\", \"--sum\", \"amount\", \"--avg\", \"other\")
    ok(p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
    ok(json.loads(p.stdout) == [
        {\"team\": \"a\", \"sum_amount\": \"0.01\", \"avg_other\": \"4\"},
        {\"team\": \"b\", \"sum_amount\": \"3\", \"avg_other\": \"4\"},
    ], \"aggregation failed\")

    unchanged = source.read_bytes()
    ok(unchanged == original.encode(), \"input was modified\")

    cases = [
        (\"empty_header.csv\", \",b\\n1,2\\n\", (), \"header\"),
        (\"dup_header.csv\", \"a,a\\n1,2\\n\", (), \"unique\"),
        (\"short.csv\", \"a,b\\n1\\n\", (), \"row\"),
        (\"long.csv\", \"a,b\\n1,2,3\\n\", (), \"row\"),
        (\"badnum.csv\", \"g,n\\na,nope\\n\", (\"--group-by\", \"g\", \"--sum\", \"n\"), \"n\"),
        (\"blanknum.csv\", \"g,n\\na,\\n\", (\"--group-by\", \"g\", \"--avg\", \"n\"), \"row 2\"),
        (\"malformed.csv\", 'a,b\\n\"unterminated,2\\n', (), \"csv\"),
    ]
    for name, content, args, needle in cases:
        path = d / name
        path.write_text(content, newline=\"\")
        p = run(path, *args)
        ok(p.returncode "'!= 0 and needle.lower() in p.stderr.lower(), f"{name}: {p.returncode=} {p.stderr=}")
        ok(p.stdout == "", f"{name}: partial output emitted")

    for args, needle in [
        (("--sum", "amount"), "group"),
        (("--group-by", "team"), "sum"),
        (("--where", "broken"), "column=value"),
        (("--where", "missing=x"), "unknown"),
        (("--group-by", "missing", "--sum", "amount"), "unknown"),
        (("--group-by", "team", "--sum", "missing"), "unknown"),
    ]:
        p = run(source, *args)
        ok(p.returncode != 0 and needle.lower() in p.stderr.lower(), f"args {args}: {p.returncode=} {p.stderr=}")
        ok(p.stdout == "", f"args {args}: partial output emitted")

print("targeted self-tests: PASS")
PY'
